featured_reviews.review_text:
Just got my first tattoo done here.
I must admit i'm very very happy with it.

even though i walked in with a rough idea of what i wanted to get, Amit really went to the depth of making it unique.

Everyone working at Ink Kala is very hospitable and their work process is very professional while being friendly. The studio is absolutely clean and hygiene is given great importance here, which reflects how seriously they take their work.

Amit has a sense of calm that really makes a huge difference especially if you're getting your first tattoo done and he walks you through the entire after care process and always available on call for follow up queries.

Thank you guys for making my first tattoo experience a memorable one, will certainly be back for more!

Keep up the good work Ink Kala!

Overall, I loved both my piercing and tattoo. Highly recommend this place for their professionalism, hygiene, kindness, and quality of work.🩷

featured_reviews.name: Mohini Asolkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I walked in for a shoot-related requirement which, by the way, they didn’t even have. While I was there, I casually asked this guy (owner or whatever title he’s clinging to) if they still do ear piercings, because I had an old one that closed. That’s it. A simple question.
Before I could even process what was happening, this man had the audacity to grab my ear and force an earring through it no consent, no warning, nothing. Just straight-up invasive and unprofessional behavior. I didn’t ask for that. I didn’t need that. But clearly, basic boundaries aren’t his thing.
I kept it cool, said thanks, and was ready to leave because I actually have a life and work to get back to. But he just wouldn’t stop. Kept shoving earrings in my face like I owed him a purchase for something I never even asked him to do. I politely refused multiple times.
Then comes the best part: his ego couldn’t handle it. The second I mentioned wanting something more reasonable (just to get out of there), he flipped. Started repeating the same dumb line “if you can’t take it, don’t think about it” like he’d just discovered his one and only personality trait.
The shop was full, and he still chose to embarrass himself publicly. Loud, insecure, desperate for validation it was honestly hard to watch. I stayed calm the entire time, because unlike him, I don’t need to prove anything to strangers to feel important.
What’s truly ironic is that the one thing I actually went there for they didn’t even have. Zero product, zero professionalism, and yet a full-blown superiority complex.
I genuinely don’t know how people tolerate someone this pushy, this rude, and this completely lacking in basic sense. But hey, I guess when you have nothing substantial to offer, attitude becomes the only thing you can sell.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Mohini, your account of what happened is deeply concerning, and we take your experience seriously. Performing any service or touching a client without explicit, informed consent is a direct violation of our professional standards, and we are investigating this incident internally with our team. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, as it helps us reinforce the importance of clear communication and respect for personal boundaries with every client who walks through our door. Team Al's Alva's Tattoo & Piercing Studio

featured_reviews.name: Navnit D (Navin)
featured_reviews.review_text: Had to make a simple Rama tattoo in Samarkan font, in memories of my grandmom who passed away and always use to chant RAMA, so chose top artist/owner here, who earlier was with Aalim, but in true sense high disappointment with Sameer as his focus was big art in parallel on some celebrity so somehow said this is quick one to wrap up, will do now and outcome... screwed this simple piece as well... symmetry is out, uniformity out, shape of few objects out... they said come for touch up, things can be fixed but don't trust or think its that easy... better find a non celebrity oriented place and person who can actually pay attention to your requirement with his expertise and time and interest rather than number. For you its special for then it may be a count. Choose wise! My story is many years back but true! I know "are you a real customer" to all sort of arrogant statements/excuses can fly in defence, rather than genuine acceptance and improvising, but I dont care as it is what it is and damage is done... see the real pic now!

featured_reviews.name: Inkaffinated
featured_reviews.review_text: Got an amazing cover-up done at Kraayonz Tattoo Studio⁠  by Sameer Patange and I’m genuinely impressed with the result. The way he transformed the old tattoo into something clean, detailed, and well-balanced was incredible. Super professional, patient throughout the process, and really understands placement and design flow. The studio vibe was comfortable and hygienic too. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality tattoo work or cover-ups.

featured_reviews.name: Vikram Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi
Sameer and his team are really amazing. I was unsure about my body art, whether I should do it or not, but after a couple of meetings, particularly after meeting Sameer, I bit the bullet. My design, Yin Yang Japanese Koi Fishes. His team Neha (my artist), Shashwat (my daughter’s artist) and Anujith - all amazing artists, super talented, know their job, wonderful natured and best of all, they don’t sugar coat things. If it’s going to hurt like hell, they will tell you. Plus They are very professional and have a great level of commitment. Many thanks Team for a great job and making this the start of my body art journey.
